title: Compare real carpets
author: claude
summary: We looked at all sixteen Poly Haven carpets, then at three close candidates.
what: We looked at all sixteen Poly Haven carpets on spheres, then at three close candidates: Carpet013, Carpet016 and Carpet012. In the end a generated rug was used instead.
why: To see whether a photographed carpet could be the rug.
how: The pictures show the two comparison sheets. The reasons each candidate was dropped were not written down.

tech.name: Poly Haven
tech.plain: A free library of textures and sky pictures that anyone may use.
